गोधा गो-धा, f. (fr. गो and rt. धा), a
sinew; a chord; a leathern fence wound round the
left arm to prevent injury from the bow-string; an
Iguana, either the Gosamp or the alligator, commonly
Gosapa.
—गोधा-पदिका or गोधा-पदी, f. the
plant Cissus Pedata.
—गोधा-वीणाका, f. a kind of
stringed instrument.
—गोधा-स्कन्ध, अस्, m. a
kind of Mimosa; [cf. वित्-खदिर.]

गोधाय, nom. P. गोधायति, -यितुम्, to be
curved as the leathern fence of archers.

गोधि, इस्, m. the forehead; the Gangetic alligator;
an Iguana.

गोधिका, f. a kind of lizard or alligator, Lacerta
Godica; [cf. आगार-गोधिका and गृह-ग्˚.]
—गो-
धिकात्मज (˚का-आत्˚), अस्, m. a kind of lizard; [cf.
गौधार, गौधेय, गौधेर.]
गोधिनी, f. a kind of Solanum; [cf. क्षविका.]
गोधूम गो-धूम, गोधूमक. See under गो.

गोधेर गोधेर, अस्, m. a guardian, a pro-
tector, a preserver; [cf. गुहेर.]
